configuration: three cross-artifact repetitions with all eight package binaries executed sequentially in each repetition
disposition: the exact disposable Windows VM was deallocated at the bound; its managed disks were retained for recovery
diagnosis: the active CPU and 1278.984897-second native baseline imply a normal second sequential repetition, not an idle hang; requiring three serial native-length executions before the only checkpoint made this diagnostic unbounded and unobservable

recovery.caveat: Azure replayed the preempted Run Command on restart. Its initialization reset the output directory before a newer helper hash stopped the replay, so no completed sequential repetition remained recoverable. This replay/preemption behavior is itself retained as rejected diagnostic evidence.

correction: the decision matrix now emits and exports an atomic SHA-256 checkpoint after every candidate and enforces a 1600-second outer per-candidate process-tree watchdog; the monolithic prototype is limited to one diagnostic repetition
